\section[utilizar]{utilizar — to use}

\label{lesson:ES-C484-utilizar}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Spanish for the improvement, then the Spanish for to go.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: utilizar}
\textbf{utilizar} — \textquotedblleft{}to use\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
Utilice la otra puerta.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Use the other door.}
\end{quote}

A formal twin of \emph{usar}.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for reading notices, forms and messages.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{utilizar}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{utilizar}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} a sentence of your own with \emph{utilizar}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Spanish for the improvement, then the Spanish for to go, then say \emph{utilizar} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does utilizar mean? (\textquotedblleft{}To use\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}

\section[(dialogue)]{Palabras de los capítulos 475-479 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:ES-R484-repaso-palabras-de-los-capitulos-475-479}



\begin{quote}
Say the Spanish for to thank for and to save.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item professional, initiative, the qualification, the material, the gardener
  \item the pupil, to practise, to understand, the mistake, bored
  \item the saving, the rent, the fine, to earn, three hundred
  \item the luggage, the footwear, the place, the space, available
  \item to sign up, to cancel, compulsory, in advance, to replace
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Professional? (\textbf{profesional}.) Initiative? (\textbf{la iniciativa}.) The qualification? (\textbf{el título}.) The material? (\textbf{el material}.) The gardener? (\textbf{el jardinero}.) The pupil? (\textbf{el alumno}.) To practise? (\textbf{practicar}.) To understand? (\textbf{comprender}.) The mistake? (\textbf{el error}.) Bored? (\textbf{aburrido}.) The saving? (\textbf{el ahorro}.) The rent? (\textbf{el alquiler}.) The fine? (\textbf{la multa}.) To earn? (\textbf{ganar}.) Three hundred? (\textbf{trescientos}.) The luggage? (\textbf{el equipaje}.) The footwear? (\textbf{el calzado}.) The place? (\textbf{el sitio}.) The space? (\textbf{el espacio}.) Available? (\textbf{disponible}.) To sign up? (\textbf{inscribirse}.) To cancel? (\textbf{cancelar}.) Compulsory? (\textbf{obligatorio}.) In advance? (\textbf{adelantado}.) To replace? (\textbf{sustituir}.)
\end{tcolorbox}

To state? (\textbf{afirmar}.) To communicate? (\textbf{comunicar}.) To interrupt? (\textbf{interrumpir}.) To promise? (\textbf{prometer}.) To complain? (\textbf{quejarse}.) To solve? (\textbf{resolver}.) To get back? (\textbf{recuperar}.) To rule out? (\textbf{descartar}.) To foresee? (\textbf{prever}.) To watch? (\textbf{vigilar}.) Specific? (\textbf{concreto}.) Similar? (\textbf{parecido}.) Fair? (\textbf{justo}.) Fast? (\textbf{rápido}.) The variety? (\textbf{la variedad}.) Childhood? (\textbf{la infancia}.) The custom? (\textbf{la costumbre}.) The purpose? (\textbf{la finalidad}.) The improvement? (\textbf{la mejora}.) To go? (\textbf{acudir}.) To use? (\textbf{utilizar}.) To make the most of? (\textbf{aprovechar}.) To support? (\textbf{apoyar}.)
